name: PP1 Language Activities Term 1 Exam
subject: Language Activities
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Your teacher will read the questions aloud.

items.question: Which letter comes first in the alphabet?
What sound does a cow make?
Which of these is a fruit?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (16 marks)
items: 1. Say and write your name. (2 marks)
2. Write the letter that comes after 'B'. (1 mark)
3. Circle the word that begins with the sound 'm': mat, sun, pot. (2 marks)
4. Draw a picture of your home and say what it is. (3 marks)
5. Name three animals you know. (3 marks)
